name: haxefmod
description: Use FMOD Studio with Haxe on HTML5, HashLink, Windows, Linux, and macOS
releasenote: Full FMOD API parity with typed declarations, callbacks with FMOD structs, and an HTML5 compile gate. Heaps and Kha join HaxeFlixel. The helper class gains banks, snapshots, and VCAs under FMOD names. Breaking release, see MIGRATION.md.
